input: head is absent or a finite acyclic singly linked list of n distinct ordinary mutable nodes with safe-integer val and writable next fields. Child/absence is another node or None/null. Sum of absolute node values is safe. Caller-held aliases may refer to original nodes. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. Python integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool.
return: Head of a list obtainable by deleting zero-sum consecutive node sequences until none remain, or absent. The declared deterministic choice skips to the farthest original occurrence of each current prefix sum; the official statement permits any fully reduced answer.
mutation_aliasing: Intentionally rewrites next links of retained original nodes; values and all original identities are preserved. Removed nodes are not destroyed and their caller aliases remain valid. One private Link sentinel has only next, never val, and is not returned. Returning a new head does not change the caller variable.
numeric: Both-pass prefix sums stay within sum(abs(values)). Equal original prefixes identify exactly a zero-sum block. Skipping such blocks preserves the prefix sum for the next retained node; no arithmetic is performed on sentinel.val. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: Expected O(n+1) time/O(n+1) auxiliary space, counting the last-prefix map retaining original node references and the one sentinel. Each pass moves forward; no node copies or recursion. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
